description.value: The Iron Horse Pub & Grill is a community pub and full-service restaurant that has anchored the small ranching community of Lone Butte for over 20 years, situated on Highway 24 ten minutes east of the Cariboo Highway 97 junction. Now under new management, it offers a family-friendly dining room alongside a pub atmosphere, making it one of very few food-and-drink stops for cyclists riding the scenic Highway 24 corridor between 100 Mile House and Little Fort.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website for theironhorsepub.ca was successfully fetched and shows an active pub and grill in Lone Butte, BC, with a 2026 copyright date and current weekly specials, confirming the business is open.
